name: devswarm-wake-watch
command: AH_ENGINE_PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "$HOME/.anti-hall/ah-engine/bin/ah-engine" devswarm wake-watch --auto; rc=$?; case $rc in 70|75|126|127) exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ah-run.sh" devswarm wake-watch -- "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/companion/lib/devswarm-wake-watch.js" --auto;; *) exit $rc;; esac
description: DevSwarm idle-wake: watches this workspace's own mailbox (read-only, poll-based) and emits a stdout line the instant new direct mesh mail lands, waking an idle session with lower latency than the cron fallback. Additive only — never disarms or replaces the unconditional CronCreate fallback (see hooks/lib/devswarm-wake.js).
